text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I arrive at the<n>cafeteria for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Apple pie slices! They look so<n>yummy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... In children's stories all over the<n>world, there
are lots of greedy bad<n>guys that eat too much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I eat a lot too... What if I turn evil?
choice_data_list: You've got plenty of time before that happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm going to resist. I don't want<n>to turn into a
bad guy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, I begin to notice Rice<n>Shower carefully
watching her portion<n>sizes.
